h: Sichon Amalek and the Roots of Holiness

p: תֵּת לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת סִיחוֹן וְגוֹ׳ (דְּבָרִים ב, לא)
to deliver Sichon before you," etc. (Devarim 2:31).
בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ (דְּבָרִים רַבָּה א, כא)
In the Midrash Rabbah on this parshah (Devarim Rabbah 1:21):
Since the nations were not commanded
would You say that if they keep it
HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to him:
all the mitzvos in the Torah,
I will cast them down before you;
'See, I have begun to deliver before you.'"
We need to understand the connection
For before this it is mentioned
מַה שֶּׁהִזְהִיר לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
that He warned Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
even though he was not commanded about it,
וְגַם לֹא עָשָׂה זֹאת בְּלֵב שָׁלֵם
and also did not do it wholeheartedly;
that he himself said in his heart (Bereishis 27:41):
"Let the days of mourning for my father draw near."
He also warned him regarding Ammon and Moav,
and this was in the merit of Lot,
וְגַם שֶׁאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מְקַפֵּחַ
and also because "HaKadosh Baruch Hu does not withhold
שְׂכַר שִׂיחָה נָאָה (בָּבָא קַמָּא לח, ב)
the reward of refined speech" (Bava Kamma 38b)
וְחָשַׁב מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּלִבּוֹ
And Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, thought in his heart:
pays the nations in this way
which is the sum of the entire Torah,
they will receive reward for it,
even though they were not commanded about it,
And the reason this matter comes
specifically with the war against Sichon:
for the land of Sichon and Og
כִּי הֲלֹא מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
for after all, Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
with the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael,
for bikkurim are not brought from it;
and as it says in Yehoshua (Yehoshua 22:19):
"But if the land of your possession
As is known, the land of the seven nations
corresponding to the seven middos of holiness,
and regarding them came the mitzvah
לֹא תְחַיֶּה כָּל נְשָׁמָה (דְּבָרִים כ, טז)
"You shall not let any soul live" (Devarim 20:16),
the Keini, the Kenizi and the Kadmoni,
which are Edom, Ammon and Moav,
which correspond to the three upper ones of holiness,
we do not yet have the strength
to refine them completely in this world
and to subdue them, until the time of the End,
as is brought from the Arizal;
therefore they were commanded regarding them
corresponding to Chochmah and Binah of holiness.
Therefore they expounded in the Midrash
"Behold, it has covered the eye of the land"
who used to guard us," etc.
for they are, one opposite the other,
corresponding to the eyes of holiness,
in these months, Tammuz and Av,
as is known from the Arizal
are the aspect of the eyes of the Matronisa.
it is said specifically about them

p: Now, the saying of our Sages, of blessed memory, is known
"And the Canaani, the king of Arad, heard," etc.
"He is Sichon, he is Arad," etc.
And in truth it was Amalek,
meaning corresponding to the aspect of Keser of holiness,
Likewise, opposite it in the kelipah,
to bring into a person's heart
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן מִשֹּׁרֶשׁ קְלִיפָּה זוֹ
was also from the root of this kelipah.
the preciousness of Yisrael by reason,
he hated their way at the root,
of the aspect of Daas of holiness,
which is the inner dimension of Keser
and is the root of the entire structure.
of the aspect of Daas of holiness,
which is recognition in one's inner self,
he was perfect in all the middos.
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, to subdue him,
וְהָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרִים מֹשֶׁה יָדוֹ וְגוֹ׳
"And it was, when Moshe raised his hand," etc.
And Yehoshua too was prepared against him
over the holiness of the bris;
for they said in the Midrash (Tanchuma Ki Seitzei 9)
that Amalek threw the circumcised flesh
and said, "Take what You have chosen,"
that Yisrael too are not worthy in this.
And Yehoshua, who came from the tribe of Yosef,
from the time they were circumcised,
even though whatever may pass over them,
because they have a bond at the root
through milah on the eighth day,
שֶׁנִּקְרָא הֵלֶךְ אוֹרֵחַ וְאִישׁ (סוּכָּה נב, ב)
who is called "traveler, guest and man" (Sukkah 52b).
The kelipah of Amalek in essence
which has not yet had any effect
in any form, in actuality, upon the soul,
who corresponds to the aspect of Chochmah of holiness,
meaning to bring the kelipah into the mind
and this corresponds to the title "guest,"
being grasped in a person's mind.
Therefore in the first war with him
he had no dominion at all
over the souls of Yisrael in actuality;
which correspond to Keser, Chochmah, Binah
even though they do not yet have refinement
nevertheless it was within the power
of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
through the war against Sichon and Og;
וְעַל זֶה רָמְזוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה
and to this our Rabbis, of blessed memory, alluded:
שֶׁעַמּוֹן וּמוֹאָב טִיהֲרוּ בְּסִיחוֹן (גִּיטִּין לח, א)
"Ammon and Moav were purified through Sichon" (Gittin 38a).
Let us return to the matter mentioned above.
When Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, came
who was clean on the surface
in all the middos in actuality,
up to the aspect of Chochmah,
וְלָכֵן אָמַר מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם בְּלִבּוֹ
therefore Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, said in his heart:
that he would be shown favor
through the performance of the mitzvos,
וְעַל זֶה הֵשִׁיב לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
And to this HaKadosh Baruch Hu answered him:
all the mitzvos in the Torah,
I will cast them down before you."
For as to Edom, Ammon and Moav,
that was only because of the light mitzvos
through which they had a connection
Esav, through honoring his father Yitzchak,
and Ammon and Moav in the merit of Lot,
who attached himself to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him.
on account of their own deeds in essence
for they have no root or branch

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 17:11 — “והיה כאשר ירים משה ידו וגבר ישראל וכאשר יניח ידו וגבר עמלק” — “Then, whenever Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed; but whenever he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.”

rich.text: “והיה כאשר ירים משה ידו וגבר ישראל וכאשר יניח ידו וגבר עמלק”

paragraphs.text: Source: Midrash Tanchuma 9:1 — “… שהיה לוהט אחר המכה, כך היה לוהט עמלק אחר ישראל ככלב. עד שיצאו ישראל ממצרים, שמע שנגאלו, ובא עליהם על הים, והזכיר עליו שם המפרש, ומיד נבהל, שנאמר: אז נבהלו …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Yeshayahu 60:21 — “ועמך כלם צדיקים לעולם יירשו ארץ נצר (מטעו) [מטעי] מעשה ידי להתפאר” — “And your people, all of them righteous, Shall possess the land for all time; They are the shoot that I planted, My handiwork in which I glory.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Sukkah 52b — “אמר רבא: בתחלה קראו ״הלך״, ולבסוף קראו ״אורח״, ולבסוף קראו ״איש״, שנאמר: ״ויבא הלך לאיש העשיר ויחמול לקחת מצאנו ומבקרו לעשות לאורח״, וכתיב: ״ויקח את כבשת האיש הרש ויעשה לאיש הבא אליו״.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 116) — “Rava said: Initially, the verse called the evil inclination a traveler coming from afar. Subsequently, the verse calls it a guest, as one welcomes it. Ultimately, the verse calls it man, indicating significance, as it became the homeowner. As it is stated in the parable of the poor man’s lamb that Nathan the prophet said …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Gittin 38a — “אשכחן גוי – גוי; גוי – ישראל, מנלן? דכתיב: ״וישב ממנו שבי״.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 87) — “The Gemara asks: We found a source for a gentile acquiring a gentile through conquest, which is an act of taking possession; from where do we derive that a gentile can also acquire a Jew through the act of possession …”
